what_it_is: The raw body of a read-only GET to the QoreChain PQC account endpoint for the coin-60 (Ethereum) account that QoreX reports on its EVM lane. Saved unedited, including field order and whitespace.
sha256_of: The stored bytes of onchain-account-qor1hklq.json, exactly as committed.
provenance: Fetched by curl in this repository's session. Only this one endpoint was called; no other chain call was made for Step 11a.
contains_key_material: Public keys only: the registered ML-DSA-87 public key (2592 bytes) and the compressed secp256k1 ecdsa_pubkey (33 bytes). Both are published on chain. No private key, seed phrase or recovery code is present.
note: The observed fields above are a reading aid. The file itself is the record; this sidecar does not replace it. created_at_height, key_type and possession_proven are identical to the owner-supplied observation (4) in docs/evidence/phase-11a-result.md, and ecdsa_pubkey_hex is identical to the owner-supplied pubKeyHex in observation (2).
